# Piloterr

Piloterr is a developer-first platform offering over 50 ready-to-use APIs for web scraping and data extraction, enabling businesses to efficiently gather and integrate web data into their systems.

Category: Developer. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/piloterr/.

## Actions

- **Auchan Product** (read-only): Retrieve detailed auchan product information.
- **Auchan Product Search** (read-only): Search for products on auchan by query or search url.
- **Get Usage** (read-only): Get usage information and remaining credits for your piloterr account.
- **Bestbuy Product Search**: Search for products on bestbuy by query.
- **Piloterr Get Product Info**: Retrieve detailed product information by product id.
